keyword_evidence: Marketplace and western decor sources show demand for horse area rugs, galloping horse rugs, equestrian doormats, western welcome mats and horse lover room decor. B029 separates similar horse products by visible art style, color palette and shopper intent.
buyer_summary: B029 buyers include horse lovers, equestrian families, western/ranch decor shoppers, farmhouse homeowners and gift buyers decorating bedrooms, living rooms, cabins and themed spaces.
purchase_concerns: Horse artwork accuracy, color match, size fit, softness, non-slip backing, washable/easy-care expectations, room style, gift relevance and avoiding unsupported outdoor durability claims.
